text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's coming together just as 
envisioned. The other positioning patterns 
to consider are—

Hokko Tarumae unleashed her final spurt 
with tremendous focus.

"That dangerous tension she used to carry 
is nowhere to be found in her now...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Could you watch me for just a 
bit longer? I feel like there are still 
things I can adjust to.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Well then—

As her Trainer, I found myself growing 
excited to see her run in the Kashiwa 
Kinen.
And then came the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Hokko Tarumae, ready to give it my all 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan's vibe has really changed 
since the Fan Thanksgiving. How do I put 
it... she's gotten so cool.

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful for this duality...! The 
gap between her concerts and regular 
streams is so good...! I stan her even 
more now...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Just when I thought I'd caught up a 
bit, looks like you've pulled ahead again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae has completely taken control of 
the room. She's so remarkably poised and 
stable...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It looks just like a mountain, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's big, holding immense power deep 
inside... Yet when you look at it from 
afar, it somehow puts you at ease. That 
kind of mountain, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Acute-san! That's exactly 
how things stand right now with Tarumae at 
the center!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, let's take a good, close 
look and feel it for ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The powerful breathing of the earth—
